subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Younger people covered their ears and laughed nervously.”?
options: For them, it was the sound of youth, hard work, and daily life.
The guide explained that food history shows trade, farming, class, and daily life.
Students visiting the gate learned that it had once controlled who entered the old city.
A teacher explained to students that the sound once controlled daily life.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「For them, it was the sound of youth, hard work, and daily life.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The guide explained that food history shows trade, farming, class, and daily life.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students visiting the gate learned that it had once controlled who entered the old city.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Younger people covered their ears and laughed nervously. A teacher explained to students that the sound once controlled daily life.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
